# `integer-size` limits integer inference (getSupportedIntegerRange): with
# int8_t, 300 and 3000000000 do not fit and become doubles; with int32_t
# only 3000000000 does.
input json TopLevel {"small": 100, "negative": -128, "medium": 300, "big": 3000000000, "list": [1, 200]}
pipeline {"lang": "cjson", "rendererOptions": {"integer-size": "int8_t"}}

render cjson {"filename": "TopLevel.h", "rendererOptions": {"integer-size": "int8_t"}}
